newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus offers up to 60 million in 91-day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus offers up to 60 million in 91-day t-bills.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank will auction up to 60 million pounds ($118.5 million) in 91-day treasury bills with an April 4 issue date, the bank announced on Monday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from March 31 to April 2.
Under central bank terms, competitive bids may be accepted in part or in whole if their price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank.
Bidders of non-competitive offers will pay the average price of all competitive bids accepted by the central bank.
Another auction for 22 million pounds' worth of 91-day bills with the same terms is due to be held on March 26.
